observations: Three horizontally ordered circle-and-vertical-line panels. Each circle has center O and a horizontal rightward radius terminating at A on the circle.
Left: vertical p is outside the circle; the extended horizontal radius reaches the line at B. Upper h bracket spans O to B, lower r bracket spans O to A. Thus h > r.
Middle: p is tangent at A; the upper h and lower r brackets span the same O-to-A interval. Thus h = r. No extra separately named B is printed here.
Right: p cuts the circle; B is the horizontal projection on p inside the O-to-A radius. Upper h bracket spans O to B; lower r bracket spans O to A. Thus h < r.
Each bracket has a visible continuous horizontal span and short endpoint turns/ticks. All six span strokes, not just h/r labels, are instructional source structure.
